question.text: Higher credit risk typically results in:

answer.text: Higher YTM (yield spread over risk-free rate)

explanation.text: The Logic: Riskier issuers must offer higher yields to compensate. The Trap: Other options misstate bond pricing. Cross-Exam Context: Same in IV, X-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Show clients the credit-quality vs yield trade-off using a simple spread curve.
